retrieval: Official GitHub API git blobs/contents, original bytes; BPE downloaded using verified HTTPS byte ranges
license: SAM License, last updated November 19, 2025; see LICENSE
scope: Unmodified official SAM 3 image model, processor, BPE asset, and eager-import dependency closure. Training/video modules are included only where imported by the official builder, not used to train or run video. No third-party inference wrapper, MMSeg, Transformers SAM3 implementation, or SAM 3.1 source.
adapter_notes: Calls official build_sam3_image_model, Sam3Processor.set_image, backbone.forward_text, and forward_grounding.
Uses pretrained text-conditioned dense semantic_seg head, not instance-mask compositing.

While the official builder executes, defers CUDA-only position/decoder-coordinate precomputation until the first forward using the original formulas, then restores both builder globals in finally. Plain caches are cleared when the adapter moves devices. Official vendored files remain unchanged.
Five prompts fixed before evaluation: lunar regolith; rock; impact crater; mountain; sky. Independent prompt scores have no sequential overwrite.
Inverse project normalization -> rounded RGB uint8 -> original processor resize to 1008 and normalize with mean/std=0.5 -> official dense logits -> bilinear to input height/width -> sigmoid.
Inference-only adaptation for this project, not an exact reproduction of the undisclosed LuSNAR SAM3 protocol.
